fix.kind: bounded, mechanical; no new rule, no new scope, no tolerance/precision/geometry change
fix.one: Corner certification now also requires the incoming leg to be covered to the vertex under the existing strict frontier/displacement accounting: certifiedUnits + displacementUnits + 1e-9 >= arcAtVertex(next). A crossing alone no longer certifies a corner when the prior leg frontier lags.
fix.two: Ordinary leg movement is strict again: the leg projection is credited only when onLeg <= coverage.units + displacementUnits + 1e-9. No max, no min-clamp toward a distant projection, no bank.
fix.three: The single exception is the corner certified in this same update, where the outgoing projection reconciles only the local residual that corner-cutting geometry creates; it is bounded by the next unreached vertex and the next ordinary update is strict again.
